text:
Ravi (Growth Marketing): Heads up — need a compact launch asset pack for the benchmark report and webinar. Focus: accessible, translatable, and quick to drop into email + webinar slides. Can we do this in 4 business days? :calendar:
Maya (DesignOps): I can coordinate. Can you list exact deliverables?
Ravi (Growth Marketing): Must-haves: 1 hero for landing + webinar thumbnail, 4 mini benchmark charts (single-axis), 4 social tiles (two aspect ratios), and an email banner. Also a Figma component library with tokens. Dark mode required. Languages: en, fr, de, es, ja.
Jordan (Product Designer): I'll create the Figma templates. Question on data: final CSV available?
Leah (Localization): I'll handle translations. Note: Spanish strings can be ~20% longer, French/German ~30% longer. Design to accommodate text expansion.
Ravi (Growth Marketing): Data is in drive: /marketing/benchmarks/2026/q1/results_public_v2.csv. Key callouts to use in copy: median latency 115ms, ~2.8x cost improvement vs baseline, 99.9% p50 uptime.
Sam (Brand): Brand reminders: use updated color tokens (brand-tokens-2026.sketch), maintain 4.5:1 contrast for body and >=3:1 for headings, avoid heavy drop shadows. Use Inter variable for UI text; use outlined logos for SVG exports.
Maya (DesignOps): For accessibility I'll include alt text CSV and a checklist. Also planning copies of each asset with increased text box widths (x1.3) for translations.
Jordan (Product Designer): Draft asset specs (put in Figma):
```
- landing hero / webinar thumb: 1200x675 px (16:9), source SVG, PNG @2x
- mini chart: responsive SVG with data overlays, export PNG @2x
- social tile: 1200x1200 px and 1200x675 px, PNG + .fig
- email banner: 600x200 px, PNG
- file naming: rwd_bench_{asset}_{lang}_{mode}.ext
```
Ravi (Growth Marketing): Also include short/long caption variants for social and the tweet-length summary.
Leah (Localization): Will provide CSVs with translations and suggested alt text translations by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Brand): Please ensure logo clearspace: 16px min and include reversed logo for dark backgrounds. No color swaps on logo.
Ravi (Growth Marketing): Legal check — can we include "2.8x cost improvement" as a headline? @LegalBot please advise.
LegalBot (legal-bot): Suggestion: add qualifying language: "Based on Redwood internal benchmark (model A on workload B). Results may vary by workload and configuration." Send methodology + CSV to legal-review@redwood.com for approval before public use. Avoid standalone absolute claims without qualifier.
Maya (DesignOps): Deliverable list (target in 4 business days): Figma library + tokens, hero (SVG + PNG), 4 chart templates (SVG + PNG), 4 social tile variants (two aspect ratios each), email banner, alt-text CSV, README with localization/layout notes, legal qualifier included on master art.
Jordan (Product Designer): For SVGs we should outline heading fonts for portability; keep live text in Figma so translators can edit. Any objections?
Sam (Brand): Outlining headings is fine for exports. Keep source files editable.
Ravi (Growth Marketing): Please upload final exports to GDrive folder marketing-assets/bench-launch/1974501123 and drop a zip in S3 marketing-exports/bench-launch/. I'll coordinate webinar slide insertion and social scheduling.
Leah (Localization): Quick note: for Japanese please use short-form variants for social if space is tight. I'll mark those in the CSV.
Maya (DesignOps): I'll add an accessibility page in Figma with contrast checks and keyboard-focus guidance for the hero (for animated web use).
Jordan (Product Designer): Starting layouts now. Ping me in thread if data updates.
Ravi (Growth Marketing): Thanks everyone. @Maya ping when first draft is ready for review, and @Sam I'll need a brand QA before final export. :raised_hands:
